messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PRODUCTION ALERT — streaming-p99 spike on prod cluster detected
IncidentBot: metric=streaming_latency_p99, value=2.34s, SLO=1.00s, model=redwood-v1-int8, affected_routes=[/v1/generate/stream], start=2341234520
devon_oncall: acked, paging ops now. I'm on it — pulling relevant dashboards.
emma_sre: oncall here too, ping if you need escalation.
frank_infra: seeing concurrent increase in KV dequant ops on the int8 nodes, CPU spikes on host-gpu-56. Logs show repeated dequant calls for long-context sessions.
devon_oncall: hypothesis: recent quant-profile rollout for redwood-v1-int8 at ~2341232000 (auto-calibration) may have introduced a hot path for long contexts. p95 only up a bit but p99 and tail stalls are bad.
caroline_support: we have 3 customer tickets mentioning stalled streaming and aborted responses (IDs #C-9421, #C-9423, #C-9427). They're on enterprise plans, some reported partial responses then stream freeze.
alice_prod: adding from prod metrics: short requests (<=128 tokens) unaffected. Long contexts (>2k tokens) show the worst p99. KV miss rate jumped.
ben_research: quick check — calibration job logs show a new dequant kernel enabled for int8 that changes KV shape packing. Could increase CPU/host transfer for large KV.
devon_oncall: immediate mitigations? Suggestions: 1) route streaming traffic for this model to fp16 variant, 2) rollback quant-profile for redwood-v1-int8, 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated pools for affected customers, 4) temporarily throttle long-context streaming.
frank_infra: I can flip routing policy to prefer fp16 for streaming endpoints. Will prepare command.
frank_infra: runbook command to change route priority (kinda urgent):
```
# set fp16 route priority for streaming
rctl routing set-priority --model redwood-v1-int8 --route /v1/generate/stream --prefer-model redwood-v1-fp16 --reason "p99 spike"
```
devon_oncall: nice — do that now and let's watch p99. Also start rollback candidate for quant profile in parallel.
frank_infra: executing now.
IncidentBot: ACTION — routing change applied by frank_infra at 2341234590.
caroline_support: told customers we're investigating and temporarily routing to alternate model. Asking for any request IDs.
devon_oncall: parallel: begin rollback of quant-profile calibration for redwood-v1-int8. Command:
```
rctl model rollback-calib --model redwood-v1-int8 --to-tag "pre-auto-calib-2341230"
```
frank_infra: rollback initiated, estimated ~60s to propagate to serving nodes.
IncidentBot: ACTION — rollback started at 2341234615.
emma_sre: monitoring p95/p99 now. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/streaming/stream-latency?orgId=1&from=now-30m
ben_research: recorded trace snippet showing repeated `dequant_kv_copy` calls stretched across the tail. Suspect memory copy + CPU serialization cost under certain attention patterns.
devon_oncall: note — this was a canary rollout last night but apparently full rollout happened across regions by orchestrator policy. We need a follow-up on rollout gating.
frank_infra: rollback reached most nodes. I'm seeing p99 drop from 2.34s -> 1.12s within 90s of rollback, streaming success rate improving.
caroline_support: customers reporting streams resuming — support updates sent. :thumbsup:
alice_prod: still seeing occasional micro-spikes (1.1-1.4s), below SLO but higher than baseline. Might be warm-up/kv-cache cold misses.
devon_oncall: plan for immediate postmortem: open INC-2341, include root cause (auto-calib->dequant kernel change), impact (3 enterprise customers affected, ~5% request aborts for long-context), mitigations (rollback, routing to fp16, throttle), follow-ups: rollout gating, calibration test harness for long-contexts.
emma_sre: I'm taking ownership for overnight handoff — will run through runbook and monitor for 6 hours. devon, can you drop any commands I need and the temporary alerts thresholds you set?
devon_oncall: handing off. Temporary alert changes:
```
# raised paging sensitivity for streaming latency
alerts set streaming_p99_urgent --threshold 1.2s --for 5m --notify oncall
```
devon_oncall: runbook excerpt pasted to INC-2341: steps to revert routing, commands to inspect dequant ops, where to find calibration logs.
frank_infra: added a flag to routing that will auto-fallback to fp16 if p99 > 1.2s for 3 consecutive evals. We'll monitor before making it permanent.
caroline_support: updating customers with status: "mitigated via routing and rollback, monitoring. Next update in 1h."
devon_oncall: leaving notes for postmortem: test vectors to reproduce long-context stall, add integration test to calibration pipeline for KV pattern A/B, add canary size/gradual ramp policy.
ben_research: follow-up item for ML: evaluate delta in dequant kernel vs previous, see whether we can optimize memory copies or change packing for long contexts.
emma_sre: accepted handoff. I'll keep the channel updated if anything flares. If p99 creeps up past 1.2s I'll page the escalation rota.
IncidentBot: RESOLVED (mitigated) — routing+rollback reduced p99 to 0.98s at 2341234765. Incident status -> Monitoring.
caroline_support: closing customer-facing ticket notes, will flag for account teams.
alice_prod: creating postmortem draft and linking to INC-2341.
devon_oncall: thanks team. Follow-ups consolidated in INC-2341 and a PR to add long-context calibration tests. :bow:
